summary: Updated shopkeeper offer date entry to use DD-MM-YYYY instead of YYYY-MM-DD. Added a shared date-format utility to convert between display format and API ISO format, updated create and edit offer forms with new labels/placeholders, validation on save, and display formatting when editing existing offers.
current_status: Offer visibility/approval work continues across backend and mobile app. Shopkeeper offer create/edit flows now accept dates in DD-MM-YYYY while still sending ISO dates to the backend API.
